options.command: just setup-workflows && node --test .github/tests/*.test.mjs && bun test --timeout 600000 scripts/tests/ci-gate-tier.test.mjs

test.//: Also runs scripts' tier-router journeys (that file only, not the packaging suite): ci-gate-tier.mjs imports macos-policy.mjs, and a scripts -> github-workflows edge would be a cycle, so classifier changes reach those tests here.

lint.//ignore-budgets: llmlint: ignore-block[new_projects_keep_the_graph_uniform] `budgets` is a gate target name here: the justfile's check recipe runs `-t format-check lint build test coverage budgets` on both tiers, so affected and run-many include it; it stays separate from `test` because the budget brief requires onebudgetspec, not the test, to compare the recorded figures against their limits.
